reference: The user-supplied code-window legend example: package labels/swatches, matching actual API identifiers and grouped rails. Its old apphost.ts filename and unverified API assumptions were not copied.

annotationContract.origin: Settled reusable contract supplied by the Aspire deck template owner; adapted to the existing HTML renderer without replacing line focus, replay, or graph behavior.
annotationContract.semantics: Package name and/or aspire add identifier, exact owned API names, optional one-based line ranges. Strings/comments do not count as API tokens. Common/core operations retain neutral syntax styling.
annotationContract.nonColorCues: Visible package/add labels, underlined identifiers with package titles, accessible legend descriptions and contiguous 4px rails outside copyable text.
annotationContract.codeSurfaceBoundary: Code/chrome stay dark in both screen themes, so package tokens use the dark-window palette. Light prose and print use their own deeper variants.
annotationContract.validation: Visible slide/block errors for unknown accents, duplicate ownership, absent/non-code APIs, missing labels/APIs, invalid/out-of-range/overlapping lines and API/range mismatches. Vite validates duplicate authored attributes before HTML normalization.

languageReferences.scope: Two explicitly labeled illustrative code blocks in an optional appendix disclosure; no original slide/text/source/notes/order/timing or weather application is replaced. Opening them switches to natural reading; reading/print expand them fully.
languageReferences.csharp: AppHost.cs, genuine top-level C# statements using the official Aspire.Hosting.Go AddGoApp integration.
languageReferences.go: main.go, a standard-library Go workload reading PORT, not a Go-authored AppHost or an invented Go AppHost SDK.
languageReferences.typescript: An authored TypeScript AppHost remains apphost.mts, not apphost.ts; no existing correct TypeScript/source block was rewritten.
languageReferences.execution: None. No Go/native/AppHost workload, package installation, profile mutation, capture rewrite or infrastructure operation was performed.

focusBands: Only the first and last lines of each contiguous focused run have 6px outside corners; joins are square. Isolated and disjoint runs round independently; source text, line ranges and navigation semantics remain exact.

navigation.reproducedBeforeFix: Browser Back from #/parser/0 to the same slide's initial #/parser history entry retained cached fragment0 and rewrote the hash back to /0, trapping history. Lifecycle reproduced identically. Toolbar Previous/ArrowLeft complete walkthroughs worked in the control.
navigation.fix: An absent fragment explicitly means -1 even for same-slide browser history. Normal native Previous restoration and explicit fragment hashes remain unchanged; no blanket reset or skipped fragments.
navigation.pointerFocusControl: Actual Inside failing controls also showed pointer Copy and a clicked non-scrolling code body trapping ArrowLeft at lifecycle/1. These paths were not covered by the old body-focused test.
navigation.keyboardOwnershipFix: A pointer Copy returns focus to the presentation; keyboard Copy keeps accessible control focus. A code/region owns navigation only when its actual scrollHeight or scrollWidth exceeds the client box. Long output and preserved-layout bodies retain native key scrolling.

speakerNotes.runtime: Existing native Reveal Notes plugin, not a custom presenter replacement.
speakerNotes.reproducedBeforeFix: Small native receiver iframes entered automatic reading, then numeric initial hashes failed lookup and the speaker current/upcoming connection never became ready.
speakerNotes.fix: Native receivers always use presentation layout, independent of their size or inherited mode=read, and hide audience toolbar chrome. Inside has no base element: native hash updates safely retain query flags and keep the current state reloadable, with history disabled in receivers. Disabling hash updates here left a stale initial preview URL, so that template-specific workaround is deliberately not transplanted. Menu and S use the same actionable blocked-popup path.
speakerNotes.preserved: All 38 original timed main-slide notes and the full 60-minute allocation remain unchanged. New illustrative references have concise separate optional cues. Notes are public source, not confidential storage.

transitions.implementation: Native Reveal only; no View Transition API wrapper or new runtime/dependency.
transitions.configuration: deck/src/transitions.ts transitionSettings defaults and real chapter-name overrides; explicit native attributes on original leaf slides win per field.
transitions.directional: Native slide/chapter in/out pairs, e.g. slide-in fade-out. Backgrounds use single native styles.
transitions.choreography: Quiet fades within chapters, a distinct restrained primary chapter entry, and one explicit existing weather-proof override. No original IDs/text/source/notes/fragments/timing changes.
transitions.static: Effective slide and background overrides are none for reduced motion, reading, print and native Notes receivers. Receiver code/graph/replay fragments still reflect exact native current/upcoming state.
transitions.validation: Unknown chapter keys and invalid styles/speeds/directional forms fail with chapter or slide identity.

protected: All 226 pre-port protected blobs, original 30 code objects, all 7 immutable full recorded responses, actual images/PR/native proof, demo/AppHost/scripts/skills/abstract and max(edge,source,target) graph gating remain unchanged.
